bmad_task.description: Move completed project to archive directory, create metadata, clean active state.

trigger.condition: Project completion confirmed (all tasks checked in plan.md)

step.mkdir: Create if doesn't exist, including subdirectories

step.fill: - project: From active.yaml - app: From active.yaml - archived_date: Current ISO timestamp - archived_by: From config.yaml (user_name) - reason: "Complete" (or user-specified) - final_status: "Complete" - total_tasks: Count tasks in plan.md - completed_tasks: Count checked boxes in plan.md - total_phases: Count phases in plan.md - final_phase: From active.yaml

step.condition: Only if tsd field in active.yaml is not empty

step.action: Copy context dumps to archive (if exist)

step.confirm: Verify archive copy successful before deleting

step.message:
✅ Project "[project-name]" archived!
**Archived to:** state/archive/[project-name]/ **Contains:** - metadata.yaml (project details) - active.yaml (final state) - plan.md (implementation plan) - tsd.md (tech spec, if existed) - context/ (context dumps, if existed)
**State cleared:** Ready for next project!
**To resume later:** 1. Copy archive/[project-name]/active.yaml → state/active.yaml 2. Invoke Nexus 3. Choose: Iterate (reimplement) or Continue (add features)

error.action: Abort with message: "Project not complete. Finish all tasks first."
Warn user, ask if should proceed anyway (partial archive)
Check permissions, retry once, abort if fails
Identify which file, check source exists, check destination writable, abort

bmad_task.notes: - Always ask user confirmation before archiving - Verify archive copy successful before deleting from state/ - Archive is immutable - don't modify archived projects - To resume: copy active.yaml back, not move (preserve archive)
